raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`Function` drops a null `strict` / `defer_loading` and keeps the client's key order (#46133), so chat templates see the tool schema as the client sent it. Function-level `defer_loading` itself came with #22702. `Tool` has no serializer, though. `serving_chat.py` renders request tools with `item.model_dump()`, so every tool reaches the chat template with an extra tool-level `"defer_loading": null` that the client never sent and that `apply_chat_template` does not render.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, one user message and two tools (`get_weather`, `run_python`). Served `usage.prompt_tokens` vs `tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tools=<client JSON>)`:

| | main | this PR | HF render |
|---|---|---|---|
| with 2 tools | 241 | **231** | 231 |
| no tools | 38 | 38 | 38 |

The 10 extra tokens on main (5 per tool) are the `"defer_loading": null` entries.

## Modifications

- `Tool` gets a wrap serializer, like `Function`'s: it drops `defer_loading` when it is `None`. An explicit `true` or `false` is kept, at both the tool and the function level.
- Every plain `Tool.model_dump()` now omits the null field:
  - the chat-template render (`serving_chat.py`, request tools and the `tool_choice`-filtered list);
  - the DSV3.2 encoder's `messages[0]["tools"]`. That encoder reads only `tool["function"]`, so its prompt does not change;
  - the tool dicts built by `function_call/base_format_detector.py` and `function_call/beam_detector.py`. Neither reads `defer_loading`. The one reader of tool dicts (`parser/glm53_chat_template.py`) treats a missing key like null.
- Dumps with `exclude_unset=True` (system-message tools, response-format paths) were already unaffected.

## Accuracy Tests

- sgl-eval gsm8k/mmlu prompts carry no tools, so this change cannot reach them; no accuracy eval was run.
- This intentionally changes the prompt for chat requests that carry tools: it now matches the client JSON and the HF render. Requests without tools are unchanged.
- Same GPU, `--enable-deterministic-inference`, greedy, 64 tokens:
  - the no-tools request gives byte-identical text on main and this PR;
  - the tools request gives the same tool call (`get_weather` with `{"city": "Paris"}`) on both.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No runtime change beyond 5 fewer prompt tokens per tool (in this example).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Three cases in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_protocol.py`: a tool without `defer_loading` dumps exactly the client dict (`model_dump` and `model_dump_json`), and an explicit tool-level `true`/`false` is kept. The tool dicts the DeepSeek-V3.2 detector hands to XGrammar's structural-tag builder are the client dicts.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No flag or documented behavior changes.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (prompt-token table and output comparison above)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Prepared with the help of Claude Code; every result above was measured as described.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -855,6 +855,14 @@ def _propagate_defer_loading(self) -> Tool:
             self.function.defer_loading = self.defer_loading
         return self
 
+    @model_serializer(mode="wrap")
+    def _serialize(self, handler):
+        # Chat templates render this dict; do not inject a field the client left out.
+        data = handler(self)
+        if self.defer_loading is None:
+            data.pop("defer_loading", None)
+        return data
+
 
 # Tool is defined after the message params that reference it, so the forward
 # reference has to be resolved explicitly.

@@ -764,6 +764,48 @@ def test_function_level_defer_loading_wins_over_tool_level(self):
         )
         self.assertFalse(tool.function.defer_loading)
 
+    def test_tool_without_defer_loading_dumps_client_fields_only(self):
+        """The dict passed to chat templates must not gain a null field."""
+        raw = {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": "search_db",
+                "description": "Search the database.",
+                "parameters": {"type": "object"},
+            },
+        }
+        tool = Tool.model_validate(raw)
+        self.assertEqual(tool.model_dump(), raw)
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(tool.model_dump_json()), raw)
+
+    def test_tool_level_defer_loading_is_kept_when_set(self):
+        for value in (True, False):
+            data = Tool(
+                defer_loading=value, function={"name": "search_db"}
+            ).model_dump()
+            self.assertIs(data["defer_loading"], value)
+            self.assertIs(data["function"]["defer_loading"], value)
+
+    def test_structural_tag_tools_are_the_client_dicts(self):
+        from unittest import mock
+
+        from sglang.srt.function_call import base_format_detector
+        from sglang.srt.function_call.deepseekv32_detector import DeepSeekV32Detector
+
+        raw = {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": "search_db",
+                "description": "Search the database.",
+                "parameters": {"type": "object"},
+            },
+        }
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            base_format_detector, "get_model_structural_tag", return_value=None
+        ) as build_tag:
+            DeepSeekV32Detector().get_structural_tag(tools=[Tool.model_validate(raw)])
+        self.assertEqual(build_tag.call_args.kwargs["tools"], [raw])
+
     def test_tool_reference_content_part_accepted(self):
         """Chat completion should accept tool_reference content on tool-role
         messages (GLM-specific extension consumed by the chat template)."""
